mapper.insert: INSERT INTO life_versions (section, reason, summary, data, created_by) VALUES (#{section}, #{reason}, #{summary}, #{data}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.section, v.reason, v.summary, v.created_by, u.name AS created_by_name, v.created_at FROM life_versions v LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = v.created_by WHERE v.section = #{section} ORDER BY v.id DESC
